headline: Weathered Expanse Flares Anew as Mooring County Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the guns have spoken anew in the Weathered Expanse: four base actions inside two hours, the latest logged shortly before filing, bringing the day's count to thirty-six, with Crow's Nest and Frostmarch again the storm centers and the Wardens' ten captures against the Colonials' six restoring their hold on six of nine posts. Stonecradle has not cooled either; three more actions fell within the last two hours, the last as this edition went to press, leaving World's End and The Reach the busiest points and the Colonials still ahead eight bases to one. In Mooring County no flag has moved since early morning, yet the casualty rolls now run past seven hundred an hour combined, the heaviest on the map, with the Wardens still holding nine posts to three. Callahan's Passage likewise yields no ground while bleeding at some four hundred and forty an hour. Farranac Coast's base fighting has been silent eight hours, though its casualty rates climb and Transient Valley remains unresolved; Stlican Shelf, the Linn of Mercy, and the Nevish Line have gone quiet. It is the 353rd day of the war; no victor is declared, and thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
